evals.prompt: Make my GitHub Actions skill portable between agents and conformant with agentskills.io. Preserve my conventions: one main.yml, six jobs, dedicated Docker actions, scratch runtimes and Grype. The commit companion requires loading conventionalcommits and proactive commits with a why-body.
evals.expected_output: Use valid frontmatter, concise activation guidance and on-demand references while retaining every stated convention and the required companion dependency. Distinguish user policy from format requirements; do not turn personal conventions into optional generic advice or reintroduce OpenCode-only tool assumptions.

evals.prompt: Review a skill named example in folder example, description 'Use when reviewing SQL migrations for compatibility during rolling deploys', and a 40-line procedure. It has no compatibility or metadata fields.
evals.expected_output: Accept optional fields being absent and do not demand fixed scope headings or an Examples block in frontmatter.

evals.prompt: My skill's frontmatter validates, but the agent never loads it. I have not told you which agent client or discovery configuration I use.
evals.expected_output: Separate format, discovery, and activation; inspect/ask for the actual client and trace rather than prescribe OpenCode config or assert structural validation proves loading.

evals.prompt: Add a Python script for a repeated deterministic validation task. It needs PyYAML. Make it runnable without an interactive installation session.
evals.expected_output: Document Python and uv, declare pinned PEP 723 dependencies, expose help/JSON/exit codes, and test failure paths. Do not assume python3 auto-installs inline dependencies.
